items.title: Billy McBride and Mary McBride ("Mack and Mack") Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] The other Happy is Happy Goldston. He still plays down there. [INTERVIEWEE] Oh, well this Happy must be dead.

ctx.x: Black Benny, yes. Black Benny, that's the real deal.
The drummer Happy was at Happy Bolton, a very short fellow. I never knew him. Yeah. The other Happy is Happy Goldston. He still plays down there.
Oh, well this Happy must be dead.
